subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should the remaining ordinary same-session visible-message fix be refreshed through PR #89238's admission-layer approach, limited to explicit control commands, or split by channel?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but the safe boundary crosses message ordering, session-state ownership, route/thread targeting, and fallback behavior that need maintainer intent before another automated repair should proceed.

options.title: Refresh PR #89238
options.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer fix on current main, preserve terminal-session recovery, and make accepted active queue-policy turns distinguishable from empty visible replies before closing #48003.

options.title: Limit To Explicit Controls
options.body: Document that ordinary visible messages continue to queue while only /steer, /tell, /queue, stop, and status-style control lanes bypass busy admission for now.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Track separate channel-specific fixes if Telegram, Discord, WebChat, and iMessage need different safe ingress boundaries before active-run queue policy.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR #89238
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer fix on current main, preserve terminal-session recovery, and make accepted active queue-policy turns distinguishable from empty visible replies before closing #48003.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on active/stopped steering direction and the terminal-session recovery that this decision must preserve.
